create_LogicalExpr: create a LogicalExpr with AND/OR/NAND/NOR type combining PDDL predicates and subexpressions
evaluate_is_true: evaluate a LogicalExpr against a PddlSimInfo to check if the expression is true
evaluate_is_true_from_predicates: evaluate a LogicalExpr against a list of Predicate objects to determine truth value
clone_LogicalExpr: clone a LogicalExpr to create an independent copy with all subexpressions duplicated
substitute_entities_sub_in_clone: substitute PDDL entities in a LogicalExpr and return a new cloned expression
